usage_note: Only the head noun 'rinktinė' declines (feminine ė-stem). The genitive modifiers 'Kanados vyrų ledo ritulio' stay unchanged. In running copy, 'Kanados rinktinė' or simply the country name 'Kanada' is used. The country name declines regularly (feminine a-stem), e.g. 'pralaimėjo Kanadai' (lost to Canada) and 'žaidė su Kanada' (played against Canada). No quotation marks are used, because this is a national team, not a club.
